Name: Golden Hour Redux (Dynamic Window Light)
Author: Latteholn
Description:
[center][img width=517]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54488/54488-1792850587-1870441819.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][b][color=#f1c232][size=6][i]Description[/i][/size][/color][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][color=#ffffff]Golden Hour Redux changes the vanilla window lighting to a more immersive one. Windows now behave more like real windows, casting light into rooms while adding ambient lighting that changes the overall atmosphere of interiors.
Lighting changes throughout the day, with luminosity and radius gradually decreasing as the day goes. Both window glow and ambient lighting adapt to your selected lighting style, creating a different atmosphere depending on the time of day.

Golden Hour Redux is a complete rework of my previous mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26426]Golden Hour Window Light.[/url] This mod is more refined (less buggy) than the other one, and is focused on making window lighting more dynamic, customizable, and atmospheric while giving you more control over how your interiors look throughout the day. [/color][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][b][color=#f1c232][size=6][i]Features[/i][/size][/color][/b][/font][/center]
[center][color=#ffffff][font=Times New Roman]- Dynamic Lighting: Windows cast light into rooms, with ambient lighting that changes the overall brightness and atmosphere.
- Time-Based Lighting: Morning, afternoon, and nighttime lighting, each with its own appearance and luminosity.
- Customizable Settings: Adjust glow luminosity, glow radius, ambient darkness, affected indoor locations, and lighting styles for each time of day. [/font][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffffff][font=Times New Roman]- Flexible Location Support: Apply the effect to all indoor locations or limit it to the farmhouse. [/font][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][b][color=#f1c232][size=6][i]Window Lights[/i][/size][/color]
[/b][color=#ffffff] - Golden Hour
- Golden Hour Vibrant
- Toned Down Golden Hour
- Pink Sunset
- Sun Catcher
- Blue Hour
- Moon Shine
- Hazy Dayz
- Blue Hour Vibrant
- Purple Sunset[/color]

[/font][font=Times New Roman][color=#f1c232][size=6][i][b]Compatibility[/b][/i][/size][/color]
[size=3][color=#ffffff] - This mod is compatible with [/color][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35690][color=#ffffff][size=3]dynamic windows[/size][/color][/url][size=3][color=#ffffff],[/color][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43126][color=#ffffff][size=3] immersive lighting[/size][/color][/url][size=3][color=#ffffff], and [/color][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40775][color=#ffffff][size=3]dynamic shader[/size][/color][/url][size=3][color=#ffffff], however if you encounter any feel free to report them in the bugs section. [/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#ffffff]- Not compatible with [/color][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41214][color=#ffffff][size=3]customizable lighting[/size][/color][/url][size=3][color=#ffffff]. And probably other mods that alter the farmhouse indoor lighting.[/color][/size]
